function.description: Returns the count of PnP network devices using filters such as state, onboarding state, device type, PID, IP, site. For device types, use these exact values: SWITCH, ROUTER, ACCESS_POINT (for APs), WIRELESS_CONTROLLER (for WLCs), MOBILITY_EXPRESS, EWC, SENSOR. For model/family fragments, use pid with wildcards (do not use exact pid unless the user gives a full model). Examples: 9200 -> pid=*9200*; AIR-AP -> pid=AIR-AP*; Cat9k -> pid in [C9200*, C9300*, C9350*, C9404R*, C9407R*, C9410R*, C9500*, C9606R*, C9610*, C9KV*]; Cat3k -> pid in [WS-C3560*, WS-C3650*, WS-C3850*]; IE-3k -> pid=IE-3?00*; ISR 4k -> pid in [ISR4321*, ISR4331*, ISR4351*, ISR4431*, ISR4451*, ISR4461*]; ASR 1k -> pid=ASR1???*. Map claimed requests to state=Planned. For site filters: use siteNameHierarchy directly, or if you need siteId, call api_getSites first. Strict prohibition: For runtime WLAN/SSID/controller detail queries that include serial number, do not call this API. Use get_device_details to resolve canonical networkDeviceId; if unresolved, ask for hostname or management IP. This API is only for explicit PnP onboarding, claim, or history workflows.
function.name: api_getPnPDeviceCount

contactedStatus.description: Filter devices by whether they have contacted the PnP server. Use CONTACTED to count devices that have connected at least once; use NOT_CONTACTED to count devices that have never connected.

deviceType.description: PnP device type filter. Supported values include Router, Switch, AP, ME, Catalyst WLC (wireless controller/WLC), EWC, and Sensor.

imageVersion.description: Filter by device software image version. Supports glob wildcards: use * to match any characters (e.g. 17.9* matches 17.9.1, 17.9.5) and ? to match a single character.

onboardingState.description: PnP device onboarding state filter (for example Planned, Onboarding).

siteNameHierarchy.description: PnP device site hierarchy name filter.

source.description: Filter by how the device was added to PnP. USER = manually added through the UI or API, NETWORK = device discovered the PnP server on bootup, SMART_ACCOUNT = synced from Cisco Smart Account inventory.

state.description: PnP device lifecycle state filter (for example Unclaimed, Planned, Provisioned, Error). For user wording 'claimed', use Planned.

svlClaimable.description: Filter for StackWise-Virtual Link (SVL) claimable neighbor devices. Set true to find devices that can be paired with a neighbor to form an SVL link.

svlDevice.description: Filter for devices that have a formed StackWise-Virtual Link (SVL) pair. Set true to find devices already in an SVL pair.
